shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
registers or stacked zones of imagery
schematic human-like figure with raised arms/limbs
repeated linear hatching used as infill texture
justification: Both are low-relief stone surfaces showing profile creatures and use repeated hatched linear infill, and each includes a small disc/rosette-like element, but that is about the extent of the correspondence. A shows a stacked, register-like assemblage of small schematic animals (quadruped, birds, snake-like forms) and abstract signs with no dominant actor, whereas B is a single large, anatomically articulate winged anthropomorphic figure filling the field with modelled musculature, elaborate patterned beard, headgear and gesturing arms — a wholly different compositional and stylistic conception.
